title: Application Entry Points
description: CLI and browser bootstrap that load environment/config and start the Strategist orchestrator or the React control-room app

title: Configuration
description: Runtime config schema, env loading, and defaults, plus event definitions, build tooling, and project-level configuration files

title: Agent Personas & Skills
description: The multi-agent system definitions: personas, operating rules, and skills that shape how each research, creation, decision, and review agent behaves

title: Documentation
description: Project planning and design documents describing the system purpose, specification, rubric, and implementation plan

title: Generated Artifacts
description: Run outputs produced by the Strategist for each event: briefs, evidence dossiers, implementation plans, shortlists, and spec docs

title: Deliberation Loop
description: The iterative debate→score→review cycle that refines ideas until unanimous approval or escalation

title: Persona System
description: 12 specialized LLM personas (researchers, creators, reviewers) loaded from .agents/personas/ markdown files

title: Multi-Provider LLM
description: Unified LLM client supporting Anthropic SDK, OmniRoute, and LiteLLM gateways with lazy provider detection

title: Control Room
description: React UI for real-time monitoring, human interjections, and gate approvals during a run

title: Artifact Pipeline
description: Produces 8 markdown files per run: spec, plan, dossier, shortlist, loop-log, approval-sheet, decision-brief, exec-summary
